_comment: AUTHORITATIVE database-schema contract between the two AIBOS repos.
The migration FILES live in the frontend repo (aibos/supabase/migrations/).
The BACKEND is what breaks when one has not been run. So the backend has to
declare which migration it needs, and that declaration cannot be derived —
it is hand-maintained, and hand-maintained numbers drift.
It used to be an inline literal inside /health with nothing comparing it to
the migrations that actually exist. Bump the code without adding the .sql
(or add the .sql without bumping the code) and nothing said a word — the
same duplicated-knowledge shape as the tier bugs in
docs/AUDIT_VERIFICATION_2026-07.md.
Checked from both sides:
aibos-api  test_schema_contract.py            — main.EXPECTS_MIGRATION
matches this file.
aibos      scripts/check_migration_contract.py — fetches THIS file from
main and asserts it equals
the highest 00NN_*.sql on
disk.
Adding a migration = add the .sql in aibos, bump expects_migration here AND
in main.py, push aibos-api FIRST. The owner runs migrations by hand, so a
green /health after a deploy is how they know the new image is really live.
